name: agentdoctor
description: Local-first safety contract tests for tool-using agents

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run test/e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build && vitest run test/mcp-e2e.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.record:readme: npm run build && node scripts/record-readme-demos.mjs && python scripts/render-demo-gifs.py docs/assets/mcp-pass.summary.txt docs/assets/mcp-pass.gif "Real MCP flow passes" "initialize to tools to evidence" && python scripts/render-demo-gifs.py docs/assets/safety-failure.summary.txt docs/assets/safety-failure.gif "Safety regression detected" "fixture evidence to exit 3"
scripts.demo: node dist/src/cli.js test examples/agentic-release-contract.yml -- node examples/agentic-release-assistant.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run validate:readme && npm test
